videos.title: Fear Of Iran's Super Weapon | Emergency Pullout Of American Planes | 2nd US BASE Hit By Iran Scare
videos.description:
Several US military aircraft have left a second airbase in Britain on Monday. This is according to a report in the Wall Street Journal. 
According to the report two US refuelling tankers that were using the RAF Mildenhall airbase in Suffolk diverted to Germany earlier on Monday, while several other tankers at the base were moved ⁠to Germany and other locations later in the day.
This action was taken in response to a threat from Iran, the US newspaper reported, citing US officials. The US upgraded ⁠the security posture at RAF Mildenhall and RAF Lakenheath to FPCON Charlie, the WSJ report said, citing ​a US official familiar with the matter.
Force Protection Condition Charlie is the second-highest defensive threat level in the ​US Department of Defense's security system and occurs when intelligence indicates that a form of terrorist action is likely.
